tooltip.darkspawn.quarantine: Each piece reduces contamination by 15 seconds. Full sealed set prevents new exposure. Iron-tier armor.
tooltip.darkspawn.bio_scanner: Sneak-use cycles nests, resources/caches and local pressure. Use scans loaded terrain within 32 blocks. Shared 5-second cooldown.
tooltip.darkspawn.contamination_cure: Contamination: slowed movement for up to 60 seconds. Honey, milk or extraction cures it.
message.darkspawn.forsaken_beacon_dimens: Containment beacons can only be powered in the Forsaken.
message.darkspawn.forsaken_beacon_active: Containment active: %s seconds remaining. Radius 16 blocks; overlaps do not stack.
message.darkspawn.forsaken_beacon_empty: Inactive. Use one Parasitic Core for five minutes of containment.
message.darkspawn.forsaken_scanner_dimen: The Bio-Scanner scans only in the Forsaken. Sneak-use changes modes.
message.darkspawn.forsaken_resources_emp: No dropped Forsaken resources or unopened cache signals within 32 loaded blocks.
message.darkspawn.forsaken_pressure_outs: Outside the active city footprint. No local infestation reading.
tooltip.darkspawn.pulse_blade: Hold Use 1.5s, release: 4-block visible-infected pulse, 10 damage, 8s cooldown, 8 durability. Melee: +25% against infected.
tooltip.darkspawn.containment_beacon: Forsaken only. One core powers a 16-block spawn-suppression field for 5 minutes. No stacking or top-ups; breaking loses fuel.
message.darkspawn.bonfire_cost: Upgrade requires %s x %s in your inventory.
tooltip.darkspawn.empty_trash: Permanently destroy the stack in the green trash slot. Take it back to cancel; closing this menu returns it.
message.darkspawn.pirate_overworld: Place and use a Sea Gate in the Overworld.
message.darkspawn.pirate_unsafe: Stand safely on land, dismount, and empty your cursor and trash slot before sailing.
message.darkspawn.pirate_unavailable: Pirate Seas is unavailable. Restart the world after installing the dimension.
message.darkspawn.pirate_blocked: The arrival area is obstructed. Clear a safe place to stand.
message.darkspawn.pirate_welcome: Welcome to Pirate Seas! Harbor: 0, 0. Use the glowing return terminal to go home.
message.darkspawn.logbound_wrong_dimensi: The Logbound Compass can be calibrated and consulted in Pirate Seas.
message.darkspawn.logbound_destination: Destination: Castaway Cove. Follow the needle; use again to check your voyage.
message.darkspawn.logbound_arrived: Logbound discovery: Castaway Cove! Explore this island for nine minutes to recalibrate.
message.darkspawn.logbound_complete: Charted island discovered. This two-island route is complete; more destinations are planned.
message.darkspawn.logbound_unavailable: This saved Logbound route is unavailable. Your progress has been preserved.
message.darkspawn.logbound_recalibrating: Recalibrating: %s:%s remaining. Explore this island; the timer pauses when you leave.
message.darkspawn.logbound_next_destinat: Compass recalibrated: follow the needle to a charted island. A new discovery awaits.
message.darkspawn.logbound_next_arrived: Logbound discovery: charted island! Explore this island for nine minutes to chart another destination.
message.darkspawn.logbound_search_failed: No unvisited island found nearby. Calibration is saved. Sail farther and use the compass to retry after 30 seconds.
subtitles.darkspawn.shanty.brothers_on_t: Nell sings: Brothers on the Water
